templates.title: Information Security Policy
templates.summary: Umbrella security policy establishing management intent, roles, and review cadence.
templates.body_markdown:
# Information Security Policy

**Organization:** {{company_name}}
**Policy owner:** {{policy_owner}}
**Effective date:** {{effective_date}}

## Purpose

{{company_name}} establishes this policy to protect information assets, meet customer and regulatory obligations, and maintain a documented security program.

## Scope

This policy applies to all workforce members, contractors, and systems that process {{company_name}} data.

## Management commitment

Management approves security objectives, allocates resources, and reviews program effectiveness at least annually.

## Roles and responsibilities

- **Policy owner** maintains this document and coordinates annual review.
- **Security team** implements technical and administrative safeguards.
- **System owners** ensure controls operate within their environments.

## Review

This policy is reviewed at least annually and after material changes to business or regulatory scope.

templates.title: Acceptable Use Policy
templates.summary: Defines acceptable and prohibited use of company systems and data.
templates.body_markdown:
# Acceptable Use Policy

**Organization:** {{company_name}}
**Policy owner:** {{policy_owner}}
**Effective date:** {{effective_date}}

## Acceptable use

Workforce members may use {{company_name}} systems only for authorized business purposes and must protect credentials and customer data.

## Prohibited activities

- Unauthorized access, sharing, or exfiltration of data
- Circumventing security controls or monitoring
- Installing unapproved software on managed devices

## Enforcement

Violations may result in access revocation, disciplinary action, or termination.

templates.title: Access Control Policy
templates.summary: Provisioning, MFA, privileged access, and periodic access review requirements.
templates.body_markdown:
# Access Control Policy

**Organization:** {{company_name}}
**Policy owner:** {{policy_owner}}
**Effective date:** {{effective_date}}

## Principles

Access is granted on least privilege, approved by managers, and removed when no longer required.

## Requirements

- Unique accounts for all users; shared credentials are prohibited.
- MFA is required for workforce access to production and administrative systems.
- Privileged access is limited, logged, and reviewed quarterly.
- Access reviews are performed at least quarterly for critical systems.

templates.title: Data Classification & Handling Policy
templates.summary: Classification tiers, encryption, retention, and secure disposal requirements.
templates.body_markdown:
# Data Classification & Handling Policy

**Organization:** {{company_name}}
**Policy owner:** {{policy_owner}}
**Effective date:** {{effective_date}}

## Classification tiers

- **Public** — approved for external release
- **Internal** — workforce use only
- **Confidential** — customer or regulated data; encryption in transit and at rest required
- **Restricted** — credentials, keys, and highly sensitive PII

## Handling

Confidential and restricted data must not be stored on unapproved devices or transmitted without encryption.
